title: concept-to-code query $def, proposed (chainlink #33)
description: The literal patch requested upstream: docs/concept-to-code-modifications.md gap #5, tracked as chainlink #33. vendor/concept-to-code/schemas/spec.schema.json's own `query` $def, field for field, plus exactly one new optional property, `witness_required` (boolean, default false), co-located with `pure` as decided. This file is NOT consumed by any of this pipeline's runtime code and is never substituted for the real vendored schema -- vendor/concept-to-code is a read-only submodule pin (docs/concept-to-code-modifications.md's own header) and this is a proposal, not an applied change; nothing here alters vendor/concept-to-code/schemas/spec.schema.json. It exists so the extension's own shape -- valid when true, valid when omitted, rejected when non-boolean, and additive over every query document valid today -- can be regression-tested before the upstream maintainer ever applies it. tests/test_concept_to_code_witness_required_schema.py asserts every field here other than witness_required is pulled verbatim from the live vendored schema at test time, so this proposal can never silently drift from what it is actually proposing a patch against.

english.description: Restricted-English question, kept verbatim as Rustdoc on the generated query.

rust_sig.description: Rust method signature. Queries must take &self and return a value.

pure.description: Queries are pure by construction; Step B rejects mutable query signatures.

witness_required.description: Declares this query a feature that must have a witness (plan.md §16.1). Optional; omission means false -- G18 (chainlink #29) reads it as the declared-feature source of truth once the query resolves. Reported upstream as docs/concept-to-code-modifications.md gap #5, chainlink #33; not applied to the vendored submodule.
